overview.description: The ProShares Equities for Rising Rates ETF (EQRR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund tracks an index of 50 US-listed large-cap stocks that are anticipated to perform favorably during periods of rising interest rates. EQRR was launched on Jul 24, 2017 and is issued by ProShares.
infoTable: Nasdaq US Large Cap Equity Rising Rates Index

holdings.infoBox: EQRR is an equity ETF with a total of 51 individual holdings. The top holdings are Marathon Petroleum stock at 4.21%, Valero Energy at 4.12%, Zscaler at 3.45%, CrowdStrike Holdings at 3.38%, and Chevron at 3.31%.
